title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Saving vs. Investing: What Is the Difference?

questions.text: According to the narration, what is the primary objective of investing?
options: To keep money safe and liquid for emergencies
To preserve capital with minimal growth
To build wealth and beat inflation over longer time horizons
To guarantee principal protection regardless of market fluctuations
questions.explanation: The narration states that the primary objective of investing is to build wealth and beat the rising cost of living, which is inflation.

questions.text: True or false: Short-term goals (one to three years) should be placed in safe, liquid savings accounts according to the golden rule.
questions.explanation: The narration explicitly says that short-term goals—anything you need money for within one to three years—belong strictly in safe, liquid savings accounts.
